description: isometric pixel art building for a fantasy village builder game, bright vivid saturated colours, crisp dark outlines, a single isolated object on a plain background, part of a stone stronghold at the edge of a forest, made of grey hewn stone, heavy timber and iron, standing directly on bare ground with no ground tile, base or platform under it, the training yard: a square of packed brown earth bordered by low stone posts, two straw training dummies on wooden poles, a rack of blunt wooden swords and spears, a wooden practice post wrapped in rope and a low stone bench, nobody on the yard, no people and no figures
